prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [140].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 140 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: cancel the room visit but keep the towel request open for desk pickup
options.zh: 取消進房服務，但保留毛巾需求，讓房客到櫃台領取
options.whyZh: 她明確取消的只有進房服務；毛巾需求沒有取消，而且她先前已選擇必要時到櫃台拿，因此不需另問地點。

options.text: cancel the visit and the towel request because the guest will not be going upstairs
options.zh: 取消進房服務和毛巾需求，因為房客不會上樓
options.whyZh: 不上樓與取消進房服務一致，但旅館把毛巾視為另一項需求，不能一併取消。

options.text: keep the room visit until the guest confirms what to do with the towels
options.zh: 保留進房服務，直到房客確認毛巾要怎麼處理
options.whyZh: 客人已清楚取消進房服務，不需要為一項仍有效的毛巾需求保留進房安排。

options.text: cancel the room visit and wait for the guest to choose where the towels should go
options.zh: 取消進房服務，等待房客選擇領取毛巾的地點
options.whyZh: 如果房客沒選過櫃台領取，不能自行把毛巾留在那裡；但這位房客已事先要求若取消進房就改到櫃台領取。

explanationZh: 她明確取消的只有進房服務；毛巾需求沒有取消，而且她先前已選擇必要時到櫃台拿，因此不需另問地點。
evidence: If a guest asks us not to enter a room, cancel the room visit. / A separate towel request should stay open unless the guest cancels it too. / The desk can hold towels only when the guest has already chosen desk pickup. / If I end up canceling the visit, please switch the towels to desk pickup. / Her note does not mention towels. / Please cancel the visit to the room.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If a guest asks us not to enter a room, cancel the room visit.
A separate towel request should stay open unless the guest cancels it too.
The desk can hold towels only when the guest has already chosen desk pickup.
If I end up canceling the visit, please switch the towels to desk pickup.
Her note does not mention towels.
Please cancel the visit to the room.

vocabulary.note: 取消進房這件事不會自動取消分開提出的毛巾需求。
